# Vendored CSS

`shadcn-tailwind-4.13.0.css` is a local CSS snapshot imported by `src/core/styles/index.css`. It supplies utility variants and animation foundations used by the current UI; removing it would change styling.

It is not an installed JavaScript framework version or a backend dependency. Its adjacent MIT license must remain with the file. Keep this snapshot deterministic. Replace or upgrade it only with a CSS-cascade comparison and browser checks, including Arabic/RTL and document printing. npm audit covers installed packages, not this source snapshot.
